title: Deepen further on top of width win (DEPTH 8->10 at ASPECT_RATIO=96)
description: Kept ASPECT_RATIO=96 (round-0 winner), increased DEPTH from 8 to 10 (n_embd 768->1024, n_head 8), dropped DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM.
reflection: val_bpb 1.037841, clearly worse than the ASPECT_RATIO=96/DEPTH=8 baseline (0.998671). This finally fills the DEPTH=10-12 gap that round-0 proposals kept flagging as untested, and confirms with real data (not just extrapolation from the DEPTH=6/14 failures at the old width) that DEPTH=8 is near-optimal even at the wider ASPECT_RATIO=96 -- deepening further does not pay for itself within the fixed 5-min budget, likely because it roughly halves the number of optimizer steps (fewer, more expensive steps lose to more, cheaper ones here). I deliberately skipped the crowded batch-size-stack experiment (all 6 round-1 proposals were identical: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^19->2^18 on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96) since duplicating a shared-budget run across all agents wastes slots -- that experiment is certain to get covered by someone else this round.
